children: Valuno Group AB (publ) issues 25,000,000 new shares upon conversion of 2,000 convertible bonds with a nominal amount of SEK 1,000,000 to Helena Global Investment Opportunities 1 Ltd.

Following registration of the conversion, 13,942 convertible bonds with a nominal amount of SEK 6,971,000 remain outstanding out of a total nominal amount of SEK 10,385,000 issued across three tranches.
The company does not disclose individual conversion notices below the threshold value. The company will provide information once the threshold is reached and shares are issued.
Peter Liljeroos, CEO, Valuno Group AB (publ)

Valuno Group AB (publ) is a Stockholm-based company listed on NGM Nordic SME, developing infrastructure for modern cross-border payments. Its Atlas platform connects bank money, stablecoins and blockchain settlement through an intelligent orchestration layer – enabling businesses to move money across borders faster, more transparently and cost-effectively. Valuno was founded in 2016 and has been listed since 2019. For more information, visit www.investor.valuno.com.

This information is information that Valuno Group AB is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-11-17 11:55 CET.
